Finca El Puente - Honey Processed

$25.00

We met Marysabel Caballero and Moisés Herrera, the owners of Finca El Puente, in 2005. They have become like family to Counter Culture, and their constant pursuit of coffee perfection inspires us year after year. This year’s harvest has rich notes of blackberry and chocolate, accented by an apricot acidity.

Pronunciation: FEEN-ka el PWEHN-teh

Origin
Marcala, Honduras
Process
Honey
Variety
Catuai, Lempira
Tasting Notes
Peach, Honey, Black Tea
